decisions.summary: Bare URLs anywhere on a page are made links by sources.linkify, called on every page's content (site_pages.shell).

decisions.summary: Second level is the primary kind in source-tags.json order; untagged canon lists its works directly.

decisions.summary: Sidebar: works sections directly under the Sources group, keys sources/<section>[/<kind>], links into the sources index, a source page opens its section and kind.
Sources index: section h3, kind h4 with its explanation as tooltip, then works; one-page Sources part the same at h5.
Home page: the Sources heading links the index, with sections, their kinds and the works nested beneath, each section and kind a block that opens on a click.
decisions.why: Now lists the works under each kind as the spec's Independent Test and FR-004 require and the GM asked ('and then list things underneath that'). The click-to-open blocks are presentation of the same nested contents, every work still present once; the GM's stated aim was browsability, which this serves rather than narrows.

decisions.summary: The one-page record's contents list the works under each kind (the canon's under its section), as they list each research section's questions.
decisions.why: Now Sources -> section -> kind -> works, matching the Independent Test and FR-004.
